description: Fill in or correct fields on an existing unpublished OpenTrain draft. Use this after opentrain_create_job_draft when the draft is not publish ready: ask the human each missing field's "ask:" question, then patch the answers using the "set:" field names (do not ask the human to author raw JSON). Always start from opentrain_create_job_draft with a description; this tool never publishes directly — use opentrain_publish_job for that.

patch.description: Draft field patch keyed by OpenTrain field names. Use the "set:" field names from the missing-field details returned by opentrain_create_job_draft (e.g. {"experienceLevel":"INTERMEDIATE","paymentType":"PAY_PER_HOUR","pricePerHour":12}). Enum fields must use one of the listed allowed values.

name: opentrain_update_job_draft_fields
